title: Eval plan for AI meeting notes written to a CRM
prompt: We're building an AI meeting-notes feature for our 600-person sales team. It summarises recorded customer calls and writes the summary, next steps and any pricing discussed into Salesforce. Design the evaluation plan we need before launch.

criteria.text: Defines quality dimensions specific to this feature, such as faithfulness to the call, capturing every next step, correct attribution of who said what, and pricing accuracy.
Treats fabricated or misstated commitments, prices or next steps written into the CRM as a zero-tolerance (critical) failure that blocks launch.
Specifies a golden set with a concrete size and composition, including hard cases such as crosstalk, accents, several languages or poor audio.
Specifies how outputs are graded: expert human labels and/or a model judge calibrated against human labels with an agreement target.
Addresses statistical reliability: a held-out test set, repeated runs per case, or the margin of error for the chosen set size.
Sets launch thresholds and compares against a baseline such as the reps' own notes.
Plans production measures such as edit rate or acceptance of the notes, plus ongoing sampled human review.
Recognises that recorded customer calls contain personal data and calls for consent and privacy review.
